source: archived host stdout; original field names prefixed log_
excludes: bootstrap/pre-update work; no timing subtraction or missing-counter imputation

semantics.KERNEL_PAIR_RESULT: one Spine propagation round; processed_edges and source_requests are work counts
semantics.CC_UPDATE_PASS: one complete Spine CC update; physical_edges/row_queries/vertex_visits are distinct work counts
semantics.SHARDED_RESULT: G+R result; processed_edge_slots_per_superstep is a layout count, not measured AXI bytes
semantics.TIMING: available host/event fields; overlapping component durations are not additive host time
